bio_en: Murat Petrosian, known as Tsronktsi Murat, came from the village of Tsronk in the Mush district and joined the ranks of the ARF's sworn fighters as a young man. He became a band commander (khmbapet) and fought for many years for the liberation of his people. He died after a long illness on 15 June 1927 at the Hammana sanatorium near Beirut, his dreams unfulfilled.
